The subject pins basedOn.leftoverJoinV39.sha256 f1bb85c2d8af39089ddfb66a2dc131dc60dd42852f556b0c18c6efa7b5382c01 and carries six recordedInputs entries for v39 and its two reviews, yet none of them is guarded. findings.whyItMatters: The remasurement clause is the only mechanism protecting the recording step from a moved input.
